requirements.title: Plectarium suite identity and product boundary
requirements.statement: Plectarium is a cohesive suite and optional control plane in the Octon ecosystem, not a capability, domain engine, or Octon dependency.
requirements.basis: Established portfolio identity and ownership decision

validation.method: boundary decision, source-map, and no-domain-semantics gates

requirements.title: Immutable multi-family capability coordinates
requirements.statement: Catalog and result identities bind family_id, capability_id, exact version, schema identity, and artifact digest to an immutable family source lock.
requirements.basis: Future family growth and FAM-036 namespace contract

validation.method: schema fixtures, family lock equality, and collision tests

requirements.title: Independent capability semantic engines
requirements.statement: Capabilities remain independently usable and Plectarium treats capability plans and payloads as contract-bound opaque domain documents.

validation.method: dependency boundaries and opaque-payload round-trip tests

requirements.title: Explicit plan and permission authority
requirements.statement: Execution requires external approval bound to the exact capability-authored plan digest; no transport, runner, result, or capability conclusion expands authority.
requirements.basis: Family authority invariants and prompt constraints

validation.method: TOCTOU, subset, denial, expiry, and transport-equivalence fixtures

requirements.title: Isolated runner modes and just-in-time credentials
requirements.statement: Local, hosted, private, customer-controlled, and air-gapped modes use operation-specific profiles, fenced leases, and opaque short-lived credential references.

validation.method: runner, lease, isolation, credential, and mode-equivalence gates

requirements.title: Immutable artifacts, provenance, compatibility, and suite BOM
requirements.statement: The suite preserves content identity, completion, freshness, checksums, signatures, lineage, limitations, and exact supported-version BOM without upgrading unknown compatibility.

validation.method: tamper, lineage, completion, compatibility, and BOM gates

requirements.title: Setup-only repository foundation
requirements.statement: Foundation work contains governance and substantive specification only; product code, dependencies, services, deployments, and production resources remain absent.

validation.method: filesystem prohibition scan and direct inventory

requirements.title: High-assurance validation and truthful readiness
requirements.statement: Harness, dossier, packet, fixtures, graphs, manifests, and checksums validate while structural success remains distinct from product readiness.
requirements.basis: Project Blueprint profile and prompt validation contract

validation.method: read-only checks, mutation tests, designated integrity refresh, and evidence review
